description: This file defines a class 'QuestionGeneratorNodes' that encapsulates the logic for generating, validating, and finalizing medical exam questions within a workflow. It interacts with external AI services, vector stores, image processing, and storage systems to produce high-quality, context-aware questions for a medical education application.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorNodes
classes.description: A class that manages the workflow nodes for generating, validating, and finalizing medical exam questions, including context retrieval, question generation, validation, and citation addition.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the QuestionGeneratorNodes with necessary clients, managers, and caches.

methods.name: _get_cached_questions
methods.description: Retrieves questions for a chapter from cache or storage, with a 30-second cache duration.

methods.name: _calculate_question_similarity
methods.description: Calculates similarity between two questions using SequenceMatcher.

methods.name: _extract_medical_terms
methods.description: Extracts key medical terms from text based on capitalization and length.

methods.name: _is_question_unique
methods.description: Checks if a new question is unique compared to existing questions based on text similarity and medical term overlap.

methods.name: _extract_covered_topics
methods.description: Extracts main topics from recent questions to avoid repetition.

methods.name: _update_chunk_quality_scores
methods.description: Updates quality scores for source chunks based on question quality.

methods.name: retrieve_context
methods.description: Retrieves relevant context chunks from vector store with smart selection based on coverage and diversity.

methods.name: generate_question
methods.description: Generates a new question using GPT-4, incorporating context and images, and checks for uniqueness.

methods.name: validate_accuracy
methods.description: Validates the generated question for medical accuracy and quality.

methods.name: add_citations
methods.description: Finalizes the question by adding source metadata, confidence scores, and updating quality metrics.
